desc: Popular brewpub offering a global pub menu, craft beers & cocktails in chill, stylish surrounds.
addr: 48, 100 Feet Rd, Defence Colony, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: We went for the unlimited sushi and dimsum. It did not disappoint!! We reached around 12:15pm and it was not crowded. It opens only at 12pm. Food and service was awesome!! Definitely will go again!! The playlist was heavenly. Kuddos to whomever chose it. They have a smoking and a non smoking area! The alcohol choce was great too.
